# Rule 2.5 Your character should be believable and realistic in-world. 
[color=lightgray]⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯[/color]
## Character Lore: • Loremasters may retcon or invalidate any character's lore at any time if it violates any of the points below. This is at their discretion; however, these decisions will be held to high scrutiny. 

• Character lore may not directly or indirectly imply significant events in AFTERLIGHT canon. 

• Characters must have realistic backstory and cannot be considered a "Mary Sue". This means that their lore should be believable and does not make them appear to be a main character. 

## Character Names: • Your name may only contain English characters. This allows accented letters. 

• Your character's name should not mimic or reference real-life or fictional characters. 

• Your character's name should not be phonetic word plays, such as "Mike Oxlong" or "Ben Dover". 

• Your name should not be overly gamey, like "John Graytide". 

• Names should not include titles, such as "Doctor," "Sergeant," or "Father".
